Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer introduced the first incorrect factual content by reporting from Britannica that Goethe “died March 22, 1832, Frankfurt am Main,” likely due to misreading/mis-scraping a glitched “Quick Facts” section. This contradicted the well-established consensus (Weimar) and led the process into a loop of resolving a non-existent discrepancy. The error stems from misinterpretation of an authoritative page snapshot without validating against the article body or cross-checking other reputable sources.
